support.claim_text: The node charges its own battery from ambient light and runs on a fraction of the energy of a smartphone.
support.quote: An onboard power chip collects ambient light to charge a built-in battery and backup energy storage units, allowing the device to run indefinitely on a fraction of the energy used by a smartphone.

support.claim_text: When it detects rising water risks it sends radio signals that can travel more than a half-mile through city streets and up to five miles in open areas to a local central hub where emergency teams can monitor conditions.
support.quote: These low-power signals can travel more than a half-mile through city streets and up to five miles in open areas without needing cell towers or power lines. The data arrives instantly at a local central hub, where emergency teams can monitor conditions from miles away.

support.claim_text: Chen Pan said the system is an off-grid solution that generates its own power and evaluates flood risk locally on the device.
support.quote: Our system is an off-grid solution. It generates its own power, evaluates flood risk locally right on the device and sends timely warnings without needing external electricity or expensive network lines.
